title: A special order not yet received is not offered with its vendor
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} (for example the first vendor in Parts → Vendors) exists.
  • Part number {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SONOTRCV-01) was requested as a special order from {Vendor-A} on work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) and ordered, and has not been received anywhere.
  • Part number {Part-A} is not an inventory part at {Location-A}.
  • Work order {Work-order-2} (for example S2-15441) is open, for a ZZAUTOTEST customer, with a line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL not received line").
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Work Orders.
  2. Open {Work-order-2}.
  3. In the Parts row of {Line-1} click + Add Part.
  4. In New Part Request, type {Part-A} in Part Number.
  5. Read every result offered for {Part-A} and the line under each.
  6. Close the dialog without saving.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: No result for {Part-A} shows the source "Part Library · {Vendor-A}": a number that was ordered but not yet received is not a special-order result.
  • Step 6: The dialog closes and nothing is added to {Line-1}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S12-R14a, S12-R14, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 6.1 (While active: GREASETUBE is found), 13 Oct copy.
